title: Open the Saga observed or compared
statement: change-saga open app.saga observes the app at HEAD, and change-saga open app.saga --against main compares what the branch changes.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Observe shows everything current: personas, features, stories, designs, test cases, and each node's code rendered as code; stale references show as health warnings.
Compare highlights the Changed, Affected, and Code layers; everything else stays reachable but de-emphasized.
The reviewer has no approval or comment controls on the documentation.
The reviewer shows a review's uncovered lines beside its deck.
